title: This Terrifying GTA 6 Easter Egg Will Give You Nightmares
description: Rockstar's GTA 6 features a massive open world to explore, and people continue to make new discoveries, including a terrifying killer clown Easter egg. It's been discovered that the Haymarket building in Vice Beach County features an elevator filled with balloons. That's creepy, but not the worst. However, after entering the elevators, the doors close and the balloons fall to the ground. As this is happening, carnival music begins to play. The balloons then mysteriously float back up to the ceiling of the elevator, as the lights flicker and the music takes on an eerie tone. Then the lights go out and a killer clown with blood on his face and a knife in his hands charges at you as the lights go out. You don't die in this interaction, but maybe that's the point: to instill even more horror that makes you question if what you saw was even real. There are lots of Easter eggs in GTA 6, including an invincible NPC who teleports and a literal Easter egg. You can also travel through time via an elaborate Easter egg. For more, check out GameSpot's rundown of all the best Easter eggs in GTA 6. You can also check out GameSpot’s GTA 6 review. If you’re just getting started with the game, be sure to read GameSpot’s top five best things to do first. The game's first patch is out now as well. GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases alone, and the game has now reportedly reached 45 million units sold and $4 billion in revenue.

title: GTA 6’s Preorder DLC Is Now Available By Itself For $5
description: Rockstar Games is now selling GTA 6 's preorder DLC as a standalone purchase. The Vintage Vice City Pack is now available to buy for $5. The DLC includes '80s-inspired content, including the '55 Vapid Stanier sedan, along with a garage for it on Ocean Beach. The DLC also comes with outfits and hairstyles for Jason and Lucia, along with a tropical pattern inspired by GTA: Vice City main character Tommy Vercetti's palm tree t-shirt. Some of the cosmetics for Jason and Lucia in the Vintage Vice City DLC. As with GTA 6's other DLC that's included in the Ultimate Edition, the Vintage Vice City content isn't unlocked all at once. Instead, players get access to it as they progress through the story. GTA 6's other extra content from the Ultimate Edition is not available separately, but people who bought the $80 edition can pay $20 to upgrade to get all of it. As announced previously, the Ultimate Edition includes tons of extra content, including a car, special guns and cosmetics for them, and access to an exclusive hair salon, tattoo parlor, and mod shop, just to name a few of the perks. GTA 6 launched on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and it reached 32.5 million copies sold via pre-purchases alone. On day one, GTA 6 generated $3.79 billion in revenue. Over the first four days, GTA 6 has climbed to 44.9 million copies sold and more than $4 billion in revenue, according to a report. For more, check out GameSpot's GTA 6 review. title: New Hunger Games Movie Blows Past Expectations After Some Feared GTA 6 Could Limit Its Reach
description: The newest Hunger Games movie, Sunrise on the Reaping, had a gigantic opening weekend that exceeded expectations. Some theorized it could struggle as people stayed home to play GTA 6, which released one day prior, but that doesn't appear to have been the case. At the domestic box office, Sunrise on the Reaping earned $120 million for its opening weekend, with $105 million more from international markets for a total of $225 million over its first three days, according to Deadline. The franchise's second prequel, after 2023's The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes, Sunrise on the Reaping tells the story of the 50th Hunger Games, where Haymitch Abernathy emerged victorious. Joseph Zada plays him; Woody Harrelson played Haymitch in the original Hunger Games films. Sunrise on the Reaping also stars Ralph Fiennes as a younger President Snow, Jesse Plemons as a younger Plutarch, and Elle Fanning as a younger Effie. With $120 million for its domestic opening, Sunrise on the Reaping is now just the second prequel film ever to start with $100 million or more domestically. The current top prequel is 2016's Star Wars movie Rogue One, which made $155 million for its domestic opening. Some had theorized that Sunrise on the Reaping could suffer as people stayed home to play GTA 6 instead. Director Francis Lawrence said, "Hopefully, people find time for both." It sure seems like he was right about that. For comparison, The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes debuted to just $44.6 million for its opening weekend in North America, so Sunrise on the Reaping is doing much better. Sunrise on the Reaping is also Lionsgate's biggest post-COVID movie and its first film that opened to $100 million or more since 2015's The Hunger Games: Mockingjay: Part 2 ($102.6 million).

title: How To Get Tommy Vercetti’s Shirt And Bike In GTA 6
description: No, your eyes are not deceiving you and yes, you can truly time travel in GTA 6. Some of you may know the name Tommy Vercetti from 2002's GTA: Vice City. Some of you may not have been born then, but are still old enough to play GTA 6. That's okay, I'm not bitter at all. Tommy Vercetti was voiced by Ray Liotta, and he was the iconic protagonist from Vice City. Having GTA 6 revisiting Vice City is enough of a reason for Rockstar to throw in one of the game's hugest Easter eggs--you can literally travel back in time to 2002, and you'll grab Tommy Vercetti's shirt and bike as a reward for doing so. The radio tower location in Key Lento. How to travel back in time in GTA 6 First of all, you'll want to go to the radio tower to the west of Key Lento and climb the stairs. When you get up there, you'll notice a few interesting posters. Turn the power switch on and press the prompt that comes up on screen. This will trigger a sound effect from Vice City. Some of the posters around the room are for LPL--the electric company in GTA 6. If you go to a nearby substation, you'll also spot some letters on the wall. There are 12 of the electric substations dotted around the map, but to save you the trouble of tracking them all down, the letters combine to form the phrase " life is passing me by." As a reminder, that's also a cheat code from Vice City. Here are the posters you can observe in the radio tower control room. Another one of the posters in the room shows a PlayStation controller and the phrase " lose track of time." Now it gets a little bit confusing, as you'll need to enter the password phrase as a cheat code using the power substations on the map. Triangle is W or Up, Circle is D or Down, Square is A and L1 is a period, or dot. After you press all of these buttons in the correct order without using fast travel, you'll get a text from an unknown number reading "U-235 REACTOR2 19-06." This means to head to Reactor 2 between 7PM and 6AM. You can find Reactor 2 in the LPL…

title: Cyberpunk 2 Is Canceled, Director Jokes, After GTA 6 Raises The Bar
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has raised the bar for open-world games, and Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzyński is feeling it. Online, the developer jokingly commented about GTA 6 setting a new gold standard for the genre, a level of quality that makes him want to pack up his Cyberpunk 2 development bags and call it a day. "GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression is real," Sarzyński wrote online. Probably the single greatest artistic achievement in history, I mean it. Scale, density, coherence, thoughtfulness of it all, just a technological and creative miracle. Cyberpunk 2 is canceled, Imma go sweep autumn leaves in my backyard now." Don't worry, Cyberpunk fans, because Sarzyński believes the game will offer a unique "flavor" compared to GTA 6. "Seriously though, I think we're doing something of our own, with a different, unique flavor," he wrote in a follow-up post. "GTA is impressive in a way all great art is; it expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed." Meanwhile, Cyberpunk 2077 has had a great 2026, as the release of the new Cyberpunk Edgerunners anime series once again drove the game's numbers up. A meaty update also helped draw new players, and Cyberpunk 2 game director Gabe Amatangelo recently shared more thoughts on how the sequel is evolving beyond his original vision as more people join the project. Other developers across the industry have also commented on GTA 6, and Naughty Dog world design director Michael Barclay also believes that it is a technological achievement. "I've made video games for 19 years, and GTA6 appears to me as a Bugatti Veyron would to a nervous Victorian child," he wrote. Payday 2 game director David Goldfarb has been utterly astonished by what he has seen so far, while The Last of Us: Part 2 and Star Wars: Jedi - Survivor character artist Del Walker wrote that he can't believe what he's seeing (and how some black magic might be involved): GTA 6 has had a phenomenal start, selling 44.9 million copies…

title: Somehow, Jensen Huang Returned
description: Nvidia has announced that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as president and CEO of Nvidia, while he'll also return to the Board of Directors. This is happening just hours after US President Donald Trump said Huang should come back. "The Board of Directors voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang following a series of discussions and meetings with Mr. Huang, after which the Board was satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead Nvidia," the technology giant said. "In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang's reinstatement poses no national security risk." Nvidia chair of the Board Harvey C. Jones said the Board believes "Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners, and customers." "We have every confidence in Jensen and look forward to working with him as he resumes his leadership of the Company. We are grateful to Colette Kress for her outstanding service as interim CEO, in addition to her continuing responsibilities as Nvidia's Chief Financial Officer," he added. Trump said in a social media post that Nvidia's Board made "the correct and proper decision" to bring Huang back. Trump went on to say that the US government has no real to believe that Huang's return "poses any risk to national security." For his part, Huang said he is honored to return to Nvidia to lead what he called "one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution." "I am also deeply thankful to our employees, shareholders, leaders across the industry and partners around the world for their extraordinary support. Above all, I am grateful for the love and support of my family. I can’t wait to get back to work.” Huang was ousted from Nvidia earlier this month after it came to light that he had a…

title: GTA 6 Is Approaching An Absurd New Sales Milestone, Report Says
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 's success continues to come into focus, as a new report from Alinea Analytics says the game sold 44.9 million copies through its first weekend. This would be up from the 32.5 million copies that Rockstar owner Take-Two announced last week, covering the game's pre-purchases alone. According to Rhys Elliott of Alinea Analytics, GTA 6 has reached 33.7 million copies sold on PS5 and 11.2 million on Xbox Series X|S, for a split of 75.1% to 24.9%. Take-Two announced $3.79 billion in sales for GTA 6 on day one, and Alinea estimated that the figure has grown to $4 billion through its first four days. Sony and Microsoft keep 30% of the revenue for digital copies via platform fees, so those companies are winners here as well. Elliott went on to point out that GTA 6's $4 billion in revenue thus far is roughly equal to the combined box office results for this year's two biggest movies, Spider-Man: Brand New Day ($2.5 billion) and The Odyssey ($1.8 billion). Of course, GTA 6 is an $80-$100 game, while (hopefully) no one is spending that much to see a movie, at least not at one time. Elliott also shared data that shows around 40.8 million people logged in to play GTA 6 on Sunday, November 22, with PS5 making up 76% of those players. Additionally, Elliott said the data shows that about 20% of players--or about 9 million people--have spent more than 20 hours in the game already. GTA 6 is only going to get bigger when it comes to sales as more and more people buy the game. Additionally, GTA 6 is expected to come to PC in 2027, which will be another selling cycle for the game. Beyond this, GTA 6 is expected to add an online mode in 2027 that will no doubt feature microtransactions and other ways for Rockstar to make money off the fanbase. For more, check out GameSpot’s GTA 6 review and our rundown of the five best things to do first. And if you’re eager for news on GTA 7? Get comfortable, because Rockstar is not going to announce it anytime soon.

title: Nightdive's Thief remaster will make the most "infamous" Thief Gold level a little less maddening, by "just kind of pointing the player in the right direction"
description: 1999's Thief Gold is widely considered the definitive incarnation of Thief: The Dark Project, adding three levels to the Looking Glass stealth sim while tidying up some bugs, but it has one grievous failing, in the eyes of many: the notorious Thieves Guild. In this all-new sixth mission, master catburglar Garrett must infiltrate the lair of a gang of pickpockets, after they filch a vase he had his eye on. The lair in question is actually very believable, as a hideout for criminals, in that it resists exploration even with a paper map. It consists of sunken, samey, obtusely arranged rooms that are made all the more headache-inducing by objectives that require a lot of backtracking. In much the same way that I can admire a finely wrought pair of thumbscrews, I think the Thieves Guild is a clever creation, one that arguably shines when you use every ability or tactic in Garrett's possession rather than trying to ghost it. But it very easily becomes frustrating, to the point that many grizzled housebreakers advise new players to skip the level entirely. The Thieves Guild should be less frustrating in Nightdive's forthcoming Thief: The Dark Project Remastered, thanks to a more revealing spread of environmental textures and various other, furtive adjustments. As with many mods or remasters that speak of boosting the "immersion", I do worry that something valuable is being sacrificed in the process. Read more

title: How To Solve The GTA 6 Bigfoot Mystery
description: There are many weird and wonderful things around Leonida. First of all, there are the GTA 6 WAiNK curiosities--remnants left behind of odd goings on that you can scan to work towards 100% completion. There are rumors of alien abduction, jet-ski-riding dogs, and unexpected cats in your passenger seat. However, one of the weirdest things to happen during my playthrough so far has been stumbling across the Bigfoot mystery. It all started when I was innocently (read: looking for drugs) wandering through the swampy areas of Leonida, and I found an effigy. I thought this might be a case of accidentally stumbling across something important, and sure enough, when I visited an ATM a few short days afterwards, I spotted a flyer that caught my attention. The flyer, in scrawled handwriting, asks that if anyone has seen "Skunk Ape" to call Kirk on 461-555-0139. Of course, I had no idea if what I had seen was whatever a Skunk Ape is, so I just called him anyway. The first time I called him, I got his voicemail saying he was in active pursuit of Skunk Ape, but that I could find him near Pelican River. When my map updated with the location, it told me to return at night time. You can see that location below, but it's to the west of Boone Speedway, among all of the marshlands. When you return at night to speak to Kirk, you'll find him in a field with a bunch of drones. I'm not sure whether I did actually see "Skunk Ape" but I told him I had anyway, and he wholeheartedly agreed with me, telling me I still had his spores on me. Mm-hmm. Kirk seems adamant that Skunk Ape and Bigfoot are two different things, and that while they share similar genes, they're different species. He can sense my doubt, clearly, as he tells me that if I want proof I need to hit his truck hard with a stick he's just thrust into my hands. Sure enough, after a short search scene, we spot Mr. Mangrove, as Kirk calls him. A cutscene will play out, and afterwards, Kirk says he'll be in touch later on. He'll give…

title: How To Get A Key Cloner In GTA 6
description: When you're using the WAiNK app to scan cars to check which security measures they have in place, you might notice that some vehicles in GTA 6 need a key cloner to gain entry. This is usually the case with more premium vehicles, and understandably, you might want to get your hands on those. You can steal most basic cars from the beginning of the game by smashing windows. This might attract a bit of attention, but you're in a pinch, right? Later on, you'll meet Moses, who will give you a slim jim to help you steal cars more efficiently--and silently. However, the most premium vehicles require a key cloner, but where can you find one of those? Well, it's actually just a case of progressing the story further. As part of the 17th GTA 6 mission, which takes place in Chapter 3, you'll be asked to steal a specific car for an NPC called Randy. He's a little similar to Moses in that he'll ask you to steal cars and reward you with good money. He'll install the Key Cloner app on your phone--so until you've progressed to this point, it's not possible to clone keys in GTA 6 any other way. How to clone keys in GTA 6 First of all, hold up on the D-Pad to use the WAiNK scanner and identify the type of security installed on a car. If you notice that a car you've got your eye on needs a cloned key to enter, you'll need to use your new app. As long as you have the app installed on your phone, walk up to the driver's side of the car and press Triangle/Y to begin using the key cloner. You'll need to rotate the right stick to find the correct spot to clone the key--a little like how hot wiring works, but with just one stick rather than both. You'll eventually be able to get in without setting off the alarm. However, remember that most keyless vehicles have trackers. You'll need to remove the tracker to ensure that the police can't locate it once it's been reported as stolen. As a tip--make sure to continue progressing through Randy's missions to learn how to remove all types of tracker.…

title: The Best Car To Register First In GTA 6
description: You’re going to love working with Moses in Grand Theft Auto 6. This particular NPC pays you a pretty decent sum for various cars that you steal, though there are some limitations. He even gives you the tools that let you stealthily jack vehicles. Still, one of his most notable functions is that he lets you register Lucia’s first car for free. That’s why, before you pick any random vehicle off the street, you must ascertain the best car to bring to Moses. This way, you don’t miss out on this really cool opportunity. In This Article When do you meet Moses in GTA 6? Options for the best car for free registration The Invetero Coquette ‘64 When do you meet Moses in GTA 6? You meet Moses during chapter 2 where you predominantly play as Lucia. You must first do a main mission called “Girls’ Trip.” The NPC from that activity, Vicki, then introduces you to Moses. Moses will give you a rundown of his services, namely paying for stolen vehicles that you bring to his shop. He’ll also help you if you want to own a stolen vehicle by getting it registered under your name. He’ll then add that the first registration is totally free. You can register the car that you brought to him as part of the introductory mission, or you can change your mind and find something else. Decline the offer for now because you still need to find a better option. Options for the best car for free registration To be frank, several options can be considered as the best cars to bring to Moses in GTA 6. But you still need to be mindful of restrictions and how the process works: At this stage, Moses will not accept cars that have trackers. The vast majority of luxury cars have standard (yellow) or advanced (red) trackers, so those are off the table. He won’t take large utility vehicles or even those driven by enemy factions. We’ve tried bringing 4x4s driven by ambushing gangsters and, even though they didn’t have trackers, he still wouldn’t accept them. You might even be tempted to deliver him Paul Walker’s…

title: GTA 6 Missing Persons Guide – How To Find Gellhorn’s Tourists
description: While exploring Port Gellhorn in Grand Theft Auto 6, you’re bound to stumble upon an intriguing mystery, one that has terrorized the backwater town and has remained unsolved for years. This objective, Gellhorn’s Missing Tourists--which leads to the Missing Person mission--happens to be one of the creepiest and most unsettling experiences in the entire game. We’ve got all the details that you need, but be ready for a few spoilers as well. Missing Person/Gellhorn’s Missing Tourists conclusion How to start the GTA 6 Missing Persons mission You can tackle the Gellhorn’s Missing Tourist objective during Chapter 2, which is when Jason and Lucia find themselves in the Starlet Motel in Port Gellhorn. If you check the reception area, you’ll see flyers that mention folks that have disappeared without a trace many years prior. In fact, there are bulletin boards, posts, and notices that have these flyers, too. As soon as you inspect the board, the number of the Kelly County Tip Line will be added to your phone. You can call it if you want, but you’ll only hear a pre-recorded message. Note: It’d be easier to do this mission during Chapter 2. If you go past that point, there might be a few obstacles in Kelly County that make it harder to get around unnoticed, if you know what we mean. The serial killer’s lair It's probably not too much of a reach to assume these missing people may have been murdered. If you feel brave enough, you can go ahead and enter the suspected lair of the potential serial killer. It’s the dilapidated Quonset hut across the street from your old pal Moses’ garage. title: Queen's Domain review
description: Where to start with Queen's Domain? It's tempting to begin with King's Field; after all, FromSoftware's seminal first-person action-RPG is an explicit inspiration for developer Freshly Baked Games. But 40 hours later, it feels like so much more. It's equally tempting to invoke another FromSoftware game: Dark Souls. Queen's Domain owes an obvious debt to that game's celebrated level design: the dazzling interconnectedness of its vertiginous world. But that's not quite right either. The deeper you delve, the more there's something of the spirit of The Legend of Zelda, a touch of Metroidvania too. Until finally you concede that Queen's Domain, with its remarkable world of densely packed secrets, is very much its own. Read more

title: Why can't you play darts in GTA 6 when you could in previous games? Because Rockstar "didn't have the resources" to do it to a standard it'd be happy with
description: If you've been a fan of Grand Theft Auto for a while, you might have noticed a strange absence in GTA 6. While the game is packed full of different activities, the recurring pastime of darts is missing, having been present in GTA 5, GTA Online, and GTA 4. Read more

title: Activision patents AI voice system that learns from in-game chat and creates audio for NPCs who can even speak in place of you
description: Call of Duty publisher Activision has filed for a new patent allowing it to train NPCs on real-world player voice chat. The patent describes an AI-driven system that listens in on player voice chat following key gameplay moments and later recreates it using in-game characters. Read more
